runs.text:
Where Light Breaks, Legends Rise — Under the shadow of a total eclipse, two powers collide. ☀️🌑🌙
Ray is back in Griza — a neon city where old ties have become true battlefields. Armed with the Power of the Sun device, he faces an impossible showdown: a dangerous gang, a threatened city, and his own sister, whom he trusted — now using the Power of the Moon against him. ⚔️

Play the official cinematic of "Arrival of the Eclipse," the new Freefire event that brings:

✦ Legendary Sets: Super heavy unisex sets
✦ Eclipse Themed Collection: Weapon skins, vehicles, emotes, and much more
✦ New Transport: Horse 🐎 (The Booyah comes galloping!)
